MAINTENANCE · Mechanical

Engine Repair in Riyadh

Engine diagnosis and repair for luxury and performance vehicles in Riyadh. From warning lights and misfires to loss of power — assessment first, clear scope before repair.

  1. Home
  2. Maintenance
  3. Engine Repair

Modern luxury engines are dense, electronically managed systems where a single symptom can have several plausible causes. A misfire may be ignition, fueling, compression or sensor data; a loss of power may be boost control, intake restriction or protective derating. QSC's engine work starts with structured diagnosis — reading what the engine reports, verifying it physically, and only then opening anything up.

PHOTO PENDING — ENGINE REPAIR

When to book this service

  • Check-engine light, reduced-power mode or repeated fault codes
  • Misfires, rough idle or hesitation under acceleration
  • Oil or coolant consumption, smoke from the exhaust, or oil leaks
  • Unusual engine noises — ticking, knocking or rattling that follows engine speed

How QSC handles it

Fault-memory readout and live-data review alongside a physical inspection

Verification tests (e.g. pressure, leak and running checks) appropriate to the symptom

A clear written finding: cause, proposed repair and what it involves

Engine repair carried out to the approved scope, followed by road testing

Frequently asked questions

My check-engine light is on but the car drives fine. Is it urgent?

A stored code with no symptom still deserves a readout — some faults do no immediate harm, others quietly cause damage or will put the car into limp mode later. A short diagnostic visit tells you which it is.

Do you repair or replace engines?

The assessment determines that. Where a targeted repair restores the engine properly, that is proposed first; where damage makes repair uneconomical, the workshop explains the alternatives before you decide.

Can you look at an engine another workshop already worked on?

Yes. Bring whatever history you have — previous reports help, but the diagnosis is done fresh.
